sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)

children.title: a) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/a) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.summary: The page displays the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Income for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The table details financial metrics including Revenue, Cost of revenue, Gross profit, Operating expenses (Research and development, Sales, general and administrative), Operating income, Net income, and Net income per share (Basic and Diluted). Key standout values include a net income of $58,321 million for the period ending April 26, 2026, compared to $18,775 million in the prior year.

children.title: b) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/b) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.summary: The page displays the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The table presents financial data in millions, detailing Net income, Other comprehensive income components (including available-for-sale securities and cash flow hedges), and Total comprehensive income.

children.title: c) Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets as of April 26, 2026 and January 25, 2026
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/c) Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets as of April 26, 2026 and January 25, 2026
children.summary: The page displays the Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries, presented in millions of dollars and marked as Unaudited. The table compares financial data across two periods: April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. It details Assets (including current assets like cash and receivables), Liabilities and Shareholders' Equity (including accounts payable and retained earnings), with a final total of $259,474 million for the most recent period.

children.title: d) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/d) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.summary: The page displays the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Shareholders' Equity for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries. It presents a table detailing changes in equity components, including Common Stock Outstanding, Additional Paid-in Capital, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Retained Earnings, and Total Shareholders' Equity. The data covers two periods: from January 25, 2026 to April 26, 2026, and from January 26, 2025 to April 27, 2025.

children.title: e) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/e) Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for the three months ended April 26, 2026 and April 27, 2025
children.summary: The page displays the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The table details cash flows from operating, investing, and financing activities in millions of dollars, showing a net income of $58,321 million for the current period compared to $18,775 million for the prior year.

children.title: f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements

children.title: Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies

children.title: Basis of Presentation
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Basis of Presentation
children.summary: The section explains that the accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC instructions for interim information. It notes that the January 25, 2026 balance sheet was derived from audited statements included in the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026. The text also states that prior fiscal year balances have been reclassified to conform to the current period presentation.

children.title: Significant Accounting Policies
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Significant Accounting Policies

children.title: Fiscal Year
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Significant Accounting Policies/Fiscal Year
children.summary: The section defines the company's fiscal year structure. It states that fiscal year 2027 is a 53-week year and fiscal year 2026 was a 52-week year, with both ending on the last Sunday in January. Additionally, it specifies the duration of specific quarters: the first quarters of fiscal years 2027 and 2026 were both 13 weeks, while the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 will be a 14-week quarter.

children.title: Principles of Consolidation
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Significant Accounting Policies/Principles of Consolidation
children.summary: The section explains that the condensed consolidated financial statements include the accounts of NVIDIA Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries. It further states that all intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated during consolidation.

children.title: Use of Estimates
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Significant Accounting Policies/Use of Estimates
children.summary: The 'Use of Estimates' section explains that preparing financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions affecting reported assets, liabilities, revenue, and expenses. It notes that actual results could differ materially from these estimates.

children.title: Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 1 - Summary of Significant Accounting Policies/Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements
children.summary: The section details a new accounting standard issued by the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) in November 2024. This standard requires additional disclosures regarding expense information, specifically for inventory purchases, employee compensation, depreciation, and intangible asset amortization. The company plans to adopt this standard in its fiscal year 2028 annual report and does not expect it to have a material impact on its financial statements other than requiring these additional disclosures.

children.title: Note 2 - Stock-Based Compensation
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 2 - Stock-Based Compensation
children.summary: This section, titled 'Note 2 - Stock-Based Compensation', outlines the company's policy for recognizing stock-based compensation expense. It specifies that expenses are recognized from grants of restricted stock units (RSUs), performance stock units (PSUs), market-based PSUs, and issuances under the employee stock purchase plan (ESPP).

children.title: Note 3 - Net Income Per Share
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 3 - Net Income Per Share
children.summary: This page contains Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for NVIDIA Corporation and Subsidiaries. It details stock-based compensation expenses by category (Cost of revenue, R&D, SG&A) for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The page also summarizes equity award activity (RSUs, PSUs) showing shares granted, vested, and outstanding, along with their weighted average fair values. Finally, it presents computations for basic and diluted net income per share.

children.title: Note 4 - Amortizable Intangible Assets and Goodwill
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 4 - Amortizable Intangible Assets and Goodwill
children.summary: This page contains Note 4 from NVIDIA Corporation's Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements, detailing Amortizable Intangible Assets and Goodwill. It presents a table comparing the gross carrying amount, accumulated amortization, and net carrying amount of intangible assets (specifically acquisition-related assets and patents) as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. Additionally, it outlines the estimated future amortization expense for fiscal years 2027 through 2032 and notes that goodwill increased by $62 million in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027.

children.title: Note 5 - Cash Equivalents and Marketable Securities
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 5 - Cash Equivalents and Marketable Securities
children.summary: This section details the composition and valuation of NVIDIA Corporation's cash equivalents and marketable securities as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. It includes a table breaking down assets by pricing category (Level 1 and Level 2), cost, unrealized gains/losses, and estimated fair value, categorized into debt securities (U.S. Treasury, corporate, government agencies, foreign bonds) and equity securities. The section also provides supplementary tables showing unrealized losses aggregated by investment category and duration, as well as the contractual maturity schedule for debt securities.

children.title: Note 6 - Non-marketable Securities
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 6 - Non-marketable Securities

children.title: Non-marketable Equity Securities
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 6 - Non-marketable Securities/Non-marketable Equity Securities
children.summary: This section details the activity and valuation of Non-marketable Equity Securities for NVIDIA Corporation. It describes that these securities are primarily in privately-held companies carried at cost less impairment, adjusted for observable price changes. A table presents the roll-forward of the carrying value for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025, showing balances, net additions, unrealized gains, reclassifications, and impairments. The text also reports cumulative gross unrealized gains and losses as of the respective period ends.

children.title: Equity Method Investments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 6 - Non-marketable Securities/Equity Method Investments
children.summary: The section details NVIDIA's investments in infrastructure funds accounted for using the equity method. As of April 26, 2026, the company held $1.0 billion in these investments with a maximum loss exposure of $2.3 billion.

children.title: Investment Commitments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 6 - Non-marketable Securities/Investment Commitments
children.summary: The section titled 'Investment Commitments' states that total investment commitments were $27 billion as of April 26, 2026. These commitments are subject to certain contingencies and are expected to be made through the remainder of fiscal year 2027.

children.title: Note 7 - Balance Sheet Components
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 7 - Balance Sheet Components
children.summary: This section defines direct customers for NVIDIA, including various types of manufacturers and service providers. It details the percentage of accounts receivable attributed to specific major customers as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. Additionally, it presents a table breaking down inventory components (Raw materials, Work in process, Finished goods) into total inventories for the periods ending April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026.

children.title: Property and Equipment:
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 7 - Balance Sheet Components/Property and Equipment:
children.summary: The section titled 'Property and Equipment' discloses the value of property, equipment, and intangible assets that were acquired but not yet paid for during the first quarter of fiscal years 2027 ($1.1 billion) and 2026 ($408 million).

children.title: Deferred Revenue
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 7 - Balance Sheet Components/Deferred Revenue
children.summary: The section titled 'Deferred Revenue' details the changes in short- and long-term deferred revenue for NVIDIA Corporation during the first quarter of fiscal years 2027 and 2026. It presents a table showing the balance at the beginning of the period, deferred revenue additions, revenue recognized, and the balance at the end of the period for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The text also notes that $451 million and $265 million of revenue were recognized from prior year-end deferred revenue balances for fiscal years 2027 and 2026, respectively. Additionally, it states that as of April 26, 2026, revenue related to remaining performance obligations from contracts greater than one year in length was $2.6 billion.

children.title: Note 8 - Derivative Financial Instruments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 8 - Derivative Financial Instruments

children.title: Foreign Currency Derivatives
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 8 - Derivative Financial Instruments/Foreign Currency Derivatives
children.summary: This section details the company's use of foreign currency forward contracts to mitigate risks associated with exchange rate movements on operating expenses and monetary assets/liabilities. It distinguishes between contracts designated as accounting hedges and those that are not, explaining how gains or losses are recorded for each category. A table presents the notional value of these outstanding contracts in millions of dollars as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. The text also notes that fair values were not significant and that all contracts mature within 18 months.

children.title: Facility Lease Guarantee
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 8 - Derivative Financial Instruments/Facility Lease Guarantee
children.summary: This section details agreements entered into during fiscal year 2026 to guarantee partners' facility lease obligations in exchange for warrants. It specifies a maximum gross exposure of $3.5 billion, which is reduced as partners make payments over terms of 5 to 7 years. Additionally, it notes that partners have placed $712 million in escrow to mitigate potential exposure and classifies these guarantees as credit derivatives.

children.title: Note 9 - Debt
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 9 - Debt
children.summary: Note 9 details the company's debt obligations as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. It includes a table listing various notes due between 2026 and 2060, showing their expected remaining terms, effective interest rates, and carrying amounts in millions. The section also provides text stating that the estimated fair value of debt was $7.4 billion and $7.5 billion for the respective dates, describes the notes as unsecured senior obligations, mentions compliance with non-financial covenants, and notes a commercial paper program capacity of $25.0 billion with no outstanding amounts.

children.title: Note 10 - Commitments and Contingencies
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 10 - Commitments and Contingencies
children.summary: This section details the company's commitments as of April 26, 2026. It outlines manufacturing, supply, and capacity commitments totaling $119 billion, with payments scheduled through fiscal year 2031. Additionally, it reports multi-year cloud service agreement commitments of $30 billion to support research and development efforts, and other vendor commitments of $6 billion.

children.title: Accrual for Product Warranty Liabilities
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 10 - Commitments and Contingencies/Accrual for Product Warranty Liabilities
children.summary: The section details the estimated product warranty liabilities for NVIDIA as of April 26, 2026 ($2.9 billion) and January 25, 2026 ($2.8 billion). It includes a table showing the activity for the three months ended on these dates, covering balances at the beginning and end of the period, additions, and utilization. The text notes that additions primarily related to the Compute & Networking segment and mentions indemnities provided for tax, product, and employee liabilities.

children.title: Litigation
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 10 - Commitments and Contingencies/Litigation
children.summary: This page from NVIDIA Corporation's financial statements details the accrual for product warranty liabilities, presenting a table of activity for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. It also outlines ongoing litigation, specifically securities class action and derivative lawsuits filed against the company regarding channel inventory and cryptocurrency mining impacts.

children.title: Accounting for Loss Contingencies
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 10 - Commitments and Contingencies/Accounting for Loss Contingencies
children.summary: The section 'Accounting for Loss Contingencies' states that as of April 26, 2026, the company has not accrued any contingent liabilities related to the legal proceedings described in the preceding text. The company believes that while liabilities are reasonably possible, they are not probable, and any potential loss cannot be reasonably estimated at this time. Additionally, the company notes that other ongoing legal actions, regulatory inquiries, and investigations could have a material adverse effect on operating results or financial position if the ultimate outcome is unfavorable.

children.title: Note 11 - Income Taxes
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 11 - Income Taxes
children.summary: Note 11 details the income tax expense for the first quarter of fiscal years 2027 ($11.6 billion) and 2026 ($3.1 billion), along with effective tax rates of 16.6% and 14.3%, respectively. The section explains that the increase in the effective tax rate was due to a lower percentage of tax benefits from stock-based compensation. It also notes that effective rates were lower than the U.S. federal statutory rate of 21% due to foreign-derived deduction eligible income, lower jurisdictional taxes, and research tax credits. Additionally, it mentions that the company is currently under examination by the Internal Revenue Service for fiscal years 2023 and 2024.

children.title: Note 12 - Shareholders' Equity
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 12 - Shareholders' Equity
children.summary: This section details the Capital Return Program under Shareholders' Equity. It reports that NVIDIA repurchased 108 million shares for $20.2 billion in Q1 fiscal 2027 and 126 million shares for $14.5 billion in Q1 fiscal 2026. As of April 26, 2026, the company was authorized to repurchase up to $38.5 billion of common stock. Additionally, on May 18, 2026, the Board of Directors approved an additional $80.0 billion in share repurchase authorization without expiration.

children.title: Note 13 - Segment Information
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 13 - Segment Information
children.summary: This section details NVIDIA's segment information, defining the 'Compute & Networking' and 'Graphics' operating segments. It includes a table presenting revenue, other segment items, and operating income for these segments for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. Additionally, it provides a reconciliation of segment operating income to consolidated income before income tax and breaks down geographic revenue based on customer headquarters location by region (United States, Taiwan, China, Other).

children.title: Note 14 - Leases
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Financial Statements (Unaudited)/f) Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements/Note 14 - Leases
children.summary: This section details NVIDIA's lease obligations, primarily operating leases for data centers and offices. It presents a table of future minimum lease payments from fiscal year 2027 through 2032 and beyond, along with the present value of these net future minimum lease payments. The text also outlines expected new lease obligations totaling $32.4 billion between fiscal years 2027 and 2033, reports operating lease costs for the first quarters of fiscal years 2027 and 2026, and provides supplemental cash flow information related to operating leases.

sections.title: Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

children.title: Forward-Looking Statements
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Forward-Looking Statements
children.summary: This section contains a legal disclaimer regarding forward-looking statements made by the company. It explains that these statements are based on management's beliefs and assumptions, subject to risks and uncertainties, and may differ from actual results. The text identifies specific terms (e.g., 'may', 'will', 'expect') used to signal such statements and directs readers to risk factors in other reports for more details. It also defines references to 'NVIDIA' or 'the Company' and includes a copyright notice.

children.title: Overview
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Overview

children.title: Our Company and Our Businesses
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Overview/Our Company and Our Businesses
children.summary: This section provides an overview of NVIDIA, describing its evolution from PC graphics to a data center-scale AI infrastructure company. It details the company's two operating segments: 'Compute & Networking' and 'Graphics'. Additionally, it states that NVIDIA is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, was incorporated in April 1993, and reincorporated in Delaware in April 1998.

children.title: Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Overview/Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges
children.summary: This section discusses revenue growth driven by data center products for accelerated computing and AI solutions, specifically noting that Blackwell accounted for the majority of system shipments. It also outlines challenges regarding the availability of data centers, energy, and capital required to support the buildout of NVIDIA AI infrastructure, highlighting regulatory, technical, and construction hurdles.

children.title: First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Summary
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Summary
children.summary: This page details risk factors and strategic outlooks for a technology company, specifically focusing on the 'Rubin platform' shipping in fiscal year 2027, H200 product licensing to China, and investments in AI ecosystems. It includes a financial table titled 'First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Summary', which presents revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and net income data for the three months ended April 26, 2026, alongside comparative figures from previous periods.

children.title: Financial Information by Business Segment and Geographic Data
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Financial Information by Business Segment and Geographic Data
children.summary: This section contains a single sentence directing the reader to Note 13 of the Notes to the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for detailed disclosure regarding segment information.

children.title: Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates
children.summary: This section states that there have been no material changes to the company's Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates since the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026.

children.title: Results of Operations
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations

children.title: Reportable Segments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Reportable Segments

children.title: Revenue by Reportable Segments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Reportable Segments/Revenue by Reportable Segments
children.summary: The section titled 'Revenue by Reportable Segments' presents a table detailing the revenue for two reportable segments, Compute & Networking and Graphics, for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The data is presented in millions of dollars and includes columns for the current period, the prior period, the dollar change, and the percentage change.

children.title: Operating Income by Reportable Segments
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Reportable Segments/Operating Income by Reportable Segments
children.summary: This section presents a table detailing the Operating Income by Reportable Segments for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. It breaks down operating income into 'Compute & Networking' and 'Graphics' segments, providing values in millions of dollars along with dollar and percentage changes. The text below explains that the increase in Compute & Networking segment operating income was driven by revenue growth and the non-recurrence of a $4.5 billion charge from the prior year, while Graphics segment growth was driven by revenue.

children.title: Concentration of Revenue
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Concentration of Revenue
children.summary: The section titled 'Concentration of Revenue' defines direct and indirect customers for NVIDIA. It details that in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers accounted for 54% of total revenue (21%, 17%, and 16%), while two direct customers accounted for 30% in the same period for fiscal year 2026. The text also notes significant revenue from a limited number of indirect customers, including one AI research company contributing meaningfully in Q1 FY2027. Additionally, it states that revenue from customers headquartered outside the United States represented 22% of total revenue in Q1 FY2027 and 42% in Q1 FY2026.

children.title: Gross Profit and Gross Margin
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Gross Profit and Gross Margin
children.summary: The section titled 'Gross Profit and Gross Margin' defines gross profit as total net revenue less cost of revenue, detailing that costs include semiconductors, assembly, labor, inventory provisions, and stock-based compensation. It reports a gross margin increase to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 from 60.5% in the prior year, primarily due to a $4.5 billion charge associated with H20 excess inventory in the previous period. The text also outlines provisions for inventory and excess purchase obligations totaling $1.1 billion and $5.3 billion for fiscal years 2027 and 2026, respectively.

children.title: Operating Expenses
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Operating Expenses
children.summary: The 'Operating Expenses' section presents a table detailing expenses for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The table lists 'Research and development' and 'Sales, general and administrative' costs in millions of dollars, along with the dollar and percentage change between the two periods. A total operating expense figure is provided, followed by an explanation that the increase in R&D expenses was driven by growth in compute infrastructure, compensation, and engineering materials.

children.title: Total Other Income, Net
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Total Other Income, Net
children.summary: The section titled 'Total Other Income, Net' presents a table detailing financial components for the three months ended April 26, 2026, and April 27, 2025. The table lists Interest income, Interest expense, and Other income (expense), net, culminating in a Total other income, net of $16,367 million for 2026 compared to $272 million for 2025. A subsequent paragraph explains that this total primarily consists of realized or unrealized gains and losses from investments in non-marketable securities and publicly-held equity securities.

children.title: Income Taxes
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Results of Operations/Income Taxes
children.summary: The 'Income Taxes' section details the income tax expense for the first quarters of fiscal years 2027 ($11.6 billion) and 2026 ($3.1 billion), along with their respective effective tax rates (16.6% and 14.3%). It explains that the increase in the effective tax rate was primarily due to a lower percentage of tax benefits from stock-based compensation relative to the increase in income before tax. The text also notes that the effective tax rates were lower than the U.S. federal statutory rate of 21% due to various factors including foreign-derived deduction eligible income, lower jurisdictional tax rates, stock-based compensation benefits, and the U.S. federal research tax credit.

children.title: Liquidity and Capital Resources
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Liquidity and Capital Resources
children.summary: The section titled 'Liquidity and Capital Resources' presents financial data regarding the company's cash position and cash flow activities. It includes a table comparing cash, cash equivalents, and marketable debt securities as of April 26, 2026, and January 25, 2026. Additionally, it provides a table detailing net cash provided by operating activities and net cash used in investing and financing activities for the three months ended April 26, 2026, compared to the same period in 2025. The text explains that increases in cash from operating activities were driven by higher revenue, while increased cash used in investing activities was primarily due to higher purchases of equity investment securities.

children.title: Liquidity
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Liquidity and Capital Resources/Liquidity
children.summary: The section outlines the company's primary sources of liquidity, including cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities. As of April 26, 2026, the company held $50.3 billion in cash and debt securities and $30.2 billion in equity securities. It discusses the composition of these marketable securities (U.S. government, corporations, etc.) and notes that substantially all funds are available for use in the U.S. without additional federal income taxes.

children.title: Capital Return to Shareholders
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Liquidity and Capital Resources/Capital Return to Shareholders
children.summary: The section details the company's capital return activities for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, including the repurchase of 108 million shares of common stock for $20.2 billion and an authorized remaining capacity of $38.5 billion. It also covers the approval of an additional $80.0 billion in share repurchase authorization on May 18, 2026, and the payment of cash dividends totaling $243 million, with a quarterly dividend increase to $0.25 per share.

children.title: Outstanding Indebtedness and Commercial Paper Program
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Liquidity and Capital Resources/Outstanding Indebtedness and Commercial Paper Program
children.summary: This section details the company's aggregate debt maturities as of April 26, 2026, broken down by time periods (due in one year, one to five years, etc.), totaling a net carrying amount of $8.47 billion and a total long-term portion of $7.47 billion. It also describes the commercial paper program, which allows for the issuance of up to $25.0 billion in unsecured notes, noting that no commercial paper was outstanding as of the reporting date.

children.title: Material Cash Requirements and Other Obligations
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Liquidity and Capital Resources/Material Cash Requirements and Other Obligations
children.summary: The section titled 'Material Cash Requirements and Other Obligations' outlines the company's future financial commitments. It references specific notes in the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for details on facility lease guarantees, long-term debt, purchase commitments, and operating lease obligations. The text also mentions continued investment in the ecosystem and discusses unrecognized tax benefits totaling $4.5 billion as of April 26, 2026, including related interest and penalties. Additionally, it states that there were no material changes outside the ordinary course of business regarding contractual obligations since the last Annual Report.

children.title: Adoption of New and Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations/Adoption of New and Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements
children.summary: The section titled "Adoption of New and Recently Issued Accounting Pronouncements" states that the company has not adopted any new or recently issued accounting pronouncements.

sections.title: Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
sections.summary: This section, titled 'Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk', focuses on 'Investment and Interest Rate Risk'. It describes the company's exposure to market price volatility regarding its publicly-held equity securities. The text details that a hypothetical 10% decrease in these securities would result in a $3.9 billion reduction in fair value as of April 26, 2026, and an $1.8 billion reduction as of January 25, 2026. It also briefly mentions the measurement basis for non-marketable equity securities.

sections.title: Item 4. Controls and Procedures
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 4. Controls and Procedures
sections.summary: This section details the company's evaluation of its disclosure controls and procedures as of April 26, 2026. Management, including the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, concluded that these controls were effective in providing reasonable assurance regarding the recording and reporting of information required under the Exchange Act. The section also notes there have been no material changes to internal control over financial reporting during the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, despite a phased upgrade of the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. Finally, it outlines inherent limitations on the effectiveness of controls, stating they can only provide reasonable, not absolute, assurance.

sections.title: Item 1. Legal Proceedings
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1. Legal Proceedings
sections.summary: The section titled 'Item 1. Legal Proceedings' refers the reader to Part I, Item 1, Note 10 of the Notes to Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for a discussion of significant developments in legal proceedings since January 25, 2026.

sections.title: Item 1A. Risk Factors
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1A. Risk Factors

children.title: Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could in the future lead to mismatches between supply and demand.
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1A. Risk Factors/Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and capacity availability, combined with a failure to estimate customer demand accurately, has led and could in the future lead to mismatches between supply and demand.
children.summary: This section details the risks associated with long manufacturing lead times, uncertain supply availability, and inaccurate demand forecasting. It explains how these factors can lead to mismatches between supply and demand, resulting in product shortages or excess inventory that negatively impact financial results. The text outlines specific causes for demand estimation errors, such as changes in technology, government policies, and customer behavior. Furthermore, it discusses the complexities of managing multiple architectures (like the Rubin platform) and the potential for inventory provisions due to low-yielding materials.

children.title: We are subject to complex laws, rules, regulations, and political and other actions, including restrictions on the export of our products, which may adversely impact our business.
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 1A. Risk Factors/We are subject to complex laws, rules, regulations, and political and other actions, including restrictions on the export of our products, which may adversely impact our business.
children.summary: This page details significant business risks related to product development, demand volatility driven by cryptocurrency mining (specifically Ethereum), and complex regulatory compliance. It discusses the impact of new use cases on revenue forecasting and outlines legal challenges involving antitrust investigations in various global jurisdictions. The text also highlights specific regulations like the EU AI Act and their potential effect on the company's operations. This page details the risks associated with government actions, trade protection policies, and export controls impacting the company's business. It highlights specific examples such as economic sanctions related to the war in Ukraine that halted sales in Russia and Belarus, and increased regulatory focus on AI technologies. The text discusses restrictions on semiconductors like GPUs, potential supply chain disruptions, and the impact of export controls on demand and inventory. This page details the impact of shifting U.S. export control restrictions on the company's ability to sell products in China and other international markets. It outlines a timeline of regulatory actions by the USG (United States Government) from August 2022 through January 2025, specifically targeting semiconductor and supercomputing industries. The text highlights specific product impacts (such as A100, H100, H20, and H200 chips), financial consequences including a $4.5 billion charge for excess inventory, and the competitive disadvantage faced due to an inability to offer compliant products to the Chinese data center market. This page details the risks associated with U.S. government export controls and legislative changes affecting the company's business, particularly regarding AI diffusion rules and GPU sales. It discusses potential impacts from the GAIN AI Act, RASA legislation, and restrictions on cloud services or products sold to China. The text also highlights competitive disadvantages caused by these regulations, specific concerns over H20 product vulnerabilities, and the impact of open-source foundation models like DeepSeek and Qwen.

sections.title: Item 2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds
sections.summary: The page details risks related to export controls and geopolitical restrictions affecting the company's business, specifically mentioning impacts in China, Europe, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. It discusses compliance obligations, potential market loss due to US government restrictions on Chinese technology, and reliance on supply chains in Taiwan and South Korea. The second half of the page outlines financial activities for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, including share repurchases totaling $20.2 billion and an increase in quarterly cash dividends.

sections.title: Item 5. Other Information
sections.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Item 5. Other Information
sections.summary: This page details share repurchase transactions for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, presenting a table with periods, total shares purchased (108.3 million), average price paid per share ($184.98), and remaining dollar value under the program ($38.5 billion). It also covers Employee Equity Incentive Program Share Withholding (approx. 12 million shares withheld) and Recent Sales of Unregistered Securities involving acquisitions on February 17 and April 10, 2026. Finally, it lists trading arrangements adopted or terminated by Board members Tench Coxe and Colette M. Kress.

sections.title: Item 6. Exhibits
sections.summary: The section titled 'Item 6. Exhibits' lists the documents filed with or incorporated by reference into the report. The table includes a Variable Compensation Plan for Fiscal Year 2027, certifications of the Chief Executive and Chief Financial Officers under Rule 13a-14(a) and (b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and various Inline XBRL taxonomy extension documents. It also provides instructions for obtaining copies of exhibits not contained in the document.

children.title: CERTIFICATION
children.path: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 Results.pdf/Signature/CERTIFICATION
children.summary: This section contains four certification documents (Exhibits 31.1, 31.2, 32.1, and 32.2) for NVIDIA Corporation's Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended April 26, 2026. The first two exhibits are certifications by Jen-Hsun Huang (President and Chief Executive Officer) and Colette M. Kress (Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer) under Rule 13a-14(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. They certify that they have reviewed the report, that it does not contain untrue statements, that the financial statements fairly present the company's condition, and they detail their responsibilities regarding disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting. The latter two exhibits are certifications by the same officers under Section 1350 of Title 18 of the United States Code, certifying that the periodic report complies with the Exchange Act and that the information presented fairly represents the company's financial condition.
